props.title: German Green Steel and Power IPO — Recap
items: FY26: revenue ₹1,678.98 Cr · PAT ₹79.89 Cr (4.76% margin)
Offer ₹303.90 Cr · fresh ₹290.00 Cr · OFS ₹13.90 Cr
Valuation: 9.32x FY26 EPS at the ₹139 cap
props.closer: Education, not advice: read the RHP, decide for yourself.

captions: This is the German Green Steel and Power I P O,
a mainboard offer,
open from the twenty-fifth to the twenty-ninth of September.
The price band is ₹132 to ₹139.
Every figure here comes from the final red herring prospectus
and exchange notices;
the final price is fixed after bidding,
so valuations are computed at the ₹139 cap.
First, the business.
German Green Steel and Power makes TMT bars,
the reinforcement steel used in construction,
which were 78.74% of FY26 revenue.
It also sells billets and sponge iron.
Its plant in Kutch, Gujarat,
is vertically integrated with a captive power plant,
and it sells through a wide Gujarat dealer network.
The financial checkpoint.
FY26 revenue was ₹1,678.98 Cr, against ₹1,507.57 Cr in FY25,
a change of 11.37%.
Profit after tax was ₹79.89 Cr, a margin of 4.76%.
Profit grew faster than revenue:
33.27% against 11.37%, with the EBITDA margin up to 9.94%.
Debt to equity eased to 0.79.
The offer size at the cap is ₹303.90 Cr.
₹290.00 Cr is fresh issue that goes into the company,
and ₹13.90 Cr is an offer for sale that goes to selling shareholders.
So 95.43% of the deal is new capital,
and 4.57% is an exit for existing holders.
Where does the money go?
Of the ₹290.00 Cr fresh issue,
₹226.33 Cr funds expansion at Samakhiyali in Kutch and a hybrid
wind and solar power plant.
₹7.70 Cr repays debt,
and the rest is for general corporate purposes.
Two promoters sell 10,00,000 shares, about ₹13.90 Cr at the cap.
Valuation.
At the ₹139 cap,
the price is 9.32x FY26 earnings of ₹14.91 a share.
Listed peers range from V M S TMT at 8.92x and Kamdhenu at
14.57x to Beekay at 22.54x and Gallant Ispat at 27.80x.
So the pricing is at the low end of the range.
Now balance the evidence.
Watch-out:
The 'German TMT' brand is licensed, not owned.
Strength:
9.32x P/E, at the low end of peers.
Watch-out:
Trademark notices from H&K over 'TMX' use.
Strength:
PAT up 33.27% to ₹79.89 Cr.
Watch-out:
₹226.33 Cr expansion must be executed.
Strength:
95.43% of the offer is fresh capital.
How to apply.
The minimum bid is one lot of 107 shares,
which is ₹14,873 at the cap.
Retail investors can bid up to two lakh rupees,
and allotment is by lottery if retail is oversubscribed.
Check live subscription on the N S E or B S E website,
not social media.
Let's recap.
FY26 revenue ₹1,678.98 Cr, profit ₹79.89 Cr.
The offer is ₹303.90 Cr, of which ₹13.90 Cr is offer for sale.
Valuation is 9.32x earnings at the cap.
The minimum investment is ₹14,873.
This video is public-source education from the red herring
prospectus and exchange notices.
It is not investment advice and not a buy or sell call.
Read the final documents,
check live subscription on the exchange,
and consult a SEBI-registered adviser.
Thanks for watching.
